Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.,C.S.C.,Pranjal Mehrotra Hon'ble Siddhartha Varma,J.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners.

The instant writ petition has been filed for directing the respondent No.4 to pass the award under the provisions of Section 31 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as "Act, 2013") in respect of the land of the petitioners acquired under award dated 25.3.2021 passed by respondent No.3.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The petitioners' land over plot No. 771, situated in Mauja Nagla Mubarik, Pargana Jauli Jansath,
Tehsil Jansath, District Muzaffarnagar, was acquired under the National Highways Act, 1956.

The Syed Abbas And Another vs Union Of India And 3 Others on 17 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29996150/
1 award for compensating the petitioners for acquisition was also passed.

entities.text: Syed Abbas And Another vs Union Of India And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioners, who claim to be the affected party as per the Act, 2013, have approached this Court.
Learned counsel for the petitioners relies heavily upon the judgement and order of this Court dated 21.2.2023 passed in Writ C No. 21601 of 2022.
In this regard, in the writ petition, we find that the petitioners have represented before the respondent No.3 on various occasions.

However, since no date has been mentioned in the representation, we direct the petitioners to file a fresh representation before the respondent No.3 and place their case as per the judgement of this Court dated 21.2.2023.
If the petitioners file a fresh representation within a period of 15 days from today, the same shall be decided within two months thereafter.
With these observations, the writ petition is disposed of.

This order has been passed in presence of Sri Alok Ranjan Sonu, Advocate appearing on behalf of Sri Pranjal Mehrotra, learned counsel for respondents No. 1 & 2 and learned Standing Counsel,
representing the State.
